# Journal of Emerging Market Finance

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** JEMF
- **Publisher:** Sage Publications (India)
- **ISSN:** 0972-6527 (print; online UNVERIFIED)
- **Homepage:** https://journals.sagepub.com/home/emf
- **Author guidelines:** https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/emf

## Scope
Per Sage: a forum for debate and discussion on the theory and practice of finance in emerging markets; emphasis on practical significance but theoretical and conceptual work on emerging financial markets also accepted. Manuscripts outside scope or below the quality bar are not reviewed.

## Scope Keywords
emerging markets, finance, stock markets, risk, portfolio, Asia, practical significance

## Article Types Accepted
- Research article — other types UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q3 — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.426; Finance Q3; Economics and Econometrics Q3 (2024 and 2025) (scimagojr.com source id 17700155035)
- **Open Access:** Subscription-access (Sage page); optional Sage Choice OA after acceptance; no mandatory APC
- **Field:** Emerging-market finance

## Special Notes
Review: double-anonymized peer review; does not accept preprints (Sage page) — check whether any preprint of this manuscript exists. Time to first decision: not published. AI policy (Sage): assistive AI (language, grammar, structure) needs no disclosure; generative AI use must be disclosed, naming the model and purpose.

## Acceptance Signals
- **Selectivity band:** accessible-to-selective (acceptance rate UNVERIFIED)
- **Desk-reject triggers:** out of scope / below quality bar (from author instructions)
- **Review process:** double-anonymized; no preprints
